meta.title: Bolt: A Global Design System
meta.description: The Bolt design system — a themeable, token-driven library kept 1:1 with code and adopted across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific at Genuine Parts Company.

hero.label: Bolt Design System
hero.title: One Design System, Three Continents
hero.subtitle: A themeable, token-driven library built end to end and kept 1:1 with code — cutting front-end development time roughly 25% and unifying product design across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific.
hero.imageAlt: Bolt UI Kit cover — the Bolt hexagon logo, version 1.0.1, marked Live and ready for consumption

context.challenge: Ship one themeable design system across three continents — with Figma that never drifts from code.
context.role: Senior Director & Head of UX Design and Research
context.scope: Global design system: foundations, tokens, component library, theming, governance
context.body: Bolt is a global, themeable design system built end to end — a token architecture and component library kept 1:1 with production code, so a design in Figma and its built counterpart never diverge. My design-engineering team built it from the foundations up: color, typography, spacing, elevation, and interaction tokens feeding a full component set, then governed its rollout across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific. The result cut front-end development time by roughly 25% and gave a Fortune Global 500 parts distributor a single, accessible design language.

sections.label: Foundations · Color
sections.title: A Tokenized Color System
sections.description: Every hue is a semantic token — static, interactive, and feedback roles, each graded weakest to strongest — so brand, state, and accessibility become decisions the system makes, not the designer. Every default pairing meets WCAG AA.
sections.imageAlt: Bolt color foundations: static, interactive, and feedback token ramps with hex values and AA contrast notes, badged with the GPC hexagon

images.alt: Bolt typographic scale — heading, body, and caption roles with sizes, weights, and line-heights defined as tokens
Bolt elevation scale — a graded set of depth and shadow tokens from flat surfaces to raised overlays

sections.label: Foundations · Layout
sections.title: Built on a Responsive Grid
sections.description: Four breakpoints, a shared gap-and-padding rhythm, and an 8px horizontal grid — documented with live column overlays at every size, capped at a 1164px content measure. Layout stops being a per-screen negotiation.
sections.imageAlt: Bolt breakpoints and grids documentation — a breakpoint table plus XSmall, Small, Medium, and Large layouts with column overlays and a 1164px max width

images.alt: Bolt spacing tokens — a scale in 4px increments shown as graded swatches, applied to gaps and margins
Bolt corner-radius tokens with a nesting diagram showing how radii step down as elements nest

sections.label: Themeable by Design
sections.title: Themeable to the Core
sections.description: Bolt themes from tokens, not overrides — every component ships light and dark from a single source of truth. Here, the full input-field system in both editions: placeholders, validation, prefixes, and focus states, all resolved from the same token names.
sections.imageAlt: The Bolt input-field system side by side in light and dark themes — placeholder, value, dropdown, currency prefix, required/error, search, and date variants with helper text

sections.title: A Library, Composed
sections.description: Not a component dump — a considered set. A few of the pieces that make Bolt feel like one product rather than a parts bin.

cards.title: Buttons
cards.description: Primary, secondary, destructive, and warning intents — each as solid, outline, and text, with every state tokenized so a button is never a one-off.
cards.imageAlt: Bolt button variants — primary blue, secondary, destructive red, and warning yellow, each in solid, outline, and text styles

cards.title: Checkboxes
cards.description: Checked, unchecked, and indeterminate — resolved in light and dark from the same token names, so state reads identically in either edition.
cards.imageAlt: Bolt checkbox states — unchecked, checked, and indeterminate — shown in both light and dark themes

cards.title: Date Range Picker
cards.description: A two-month range picker with smart presets — the kind of complex input that usually fragments across teams, solved once.
cards.imageAlt: Bolt date-range picker showing February and March 2025 side by side with Last 10/30/60/90-day presets and a reset action

cards.title: Selection Cards
cards.description: Radio and checkbox choices promoted to first-class, describable cards with selected, hover, and disabled states.
cards.imageAlt: Bolt selection cards with title and description, shown in unselected, selected, and disabled states

cards.title: Avatars
cards.description: Identity at every size — photo, initials, and fallback — so people read consistently across the whole product.
cards.imageAlt: Bolt avatar system: a grid of photo, initials, and placeholder avatars across multiple sizes

cards.title: Order Tracker
cards.description: A domain-aware progress tracker — order placed to delivered — proving the system carries real commerce flows, not just controls.
cards.imageAlt: Bolt order-status tracker stepping through Order Placed, Invoice Created, Preparing Order, Out for Delivery, and Delivered with completed checkmarks
